name: navilite
description: A deliberately lightweight Navidrome (Subsonic) music player with a real audio spectrum, shipped as a PWA, an Android APK and an iOS IPA from one TypeScript codebase.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run patch:native && npm run build && cap sync
scripts.apk: npm run patch:native && npm run build && cap sync android && bash tools/build-apk.sh debug
scripts.apk:release: npm run patch:native && npm run build && cap sync android && bash tools/build-apk.sh release
scripts.ipa:unsigned: npm run patch:native && npm run build && cap sync ios && bash tools/build-ios-ipa.sh
scripts.ipa:simulator: npm run patch:native && npm run build && cap sync ios && bash tools/build-ios-ipa.sh --simulator
